text: #271's amendment to factory/recovery, ratified by hand: the core follows a ratified proposal's latest build, and each writer's retry starts a new build, with its own agent run, that replaces the failed draft the build before left. Before it closes that draft, the factory stores a record, where every watcher can read it, that the retry replaces it; then it closes the draft and answers the retry, and the new build opens its own pull request, ready or as a draft, and is answered apart. A retry whose draft someone merged, or closed before the record was stored, is answered without a build, and a watcher still in an agent run that a retry superseded never counts it for the new build. OnePullRequest is weakened: each build opens at most one pull request, where before the ratification opened at most one in all. GatedPullRequestsSettled is narrowed: it no longer covers a failed draft, which waits for a writer's retry, and a pull request someone else merged or closed is settled once the factory reports it. The amendment adds the invariants OneOpenPullRequest, RetiredOnlyByRecord, NoReplacingMerged, OwnGate and OwnRun, the property BuildsAnswered, six witnesses and seven known bugs, and extends NoDoubleAnswer and CommandsAnswered to retries. The model forgets each finished build except the draft the latest retry replaces, so it covers any number of retries, and a writer's retry comes once every command before it is answered. The lock amends proposal sha256:85b44c9f1da81dc071bd946a6095d75267a92ef8601c5d17aff2163b0254b976, ratified on #68, with proposal sha256:3de3518314501a3649b21ac96135dac5505dd50dffbf808c8bee28438392b7be, and this decision records its ratification in place of a ratifying comment. The watcher takes none of the new effects until #271's plumbing connects them.
